properties.title: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued July 9 at 4:57AM CDT until July 9 at 5:30AM CDT by NWS Kansas City/Pleasant Hill MO
properties.description:
At 456 AM CDT, severe thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from near Oak Grove to 6 miles northwest of Montrose,
moving east at 35 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and penny size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
Warrensburg, Holden, Garden City, Urich, Creighton, Chilhowee,
Kingsville, Lake Lafayette, Centerview, Gunn City, Blairstown,
Fayetteville, La Tour, Ballard, Pittsville, Hartwell, La Due, and
Quick City.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.
properties.area: Bates, MO; Cass, MO; Henry, MO; Johnson, MO; Lafayette, MO

properties.title: Special Marine Warning issued July 9 at 5:45AM EDT until July 9 at 6:30AM EDT by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
properties.description:
SMWMHX

The National Weather Service in Newport has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Waters from Cape Hatteras to Ocracoke Inlet NC from 20 to 60 NM...
Waters from Oregon Inlet to Cape Hatteras NC from 20 to 60 NM...

* Until 630 AM EDT.

* At 544 AM EDT, a strong thunderstorm was located 45 nm southeast of
Diamond Shoals, moving east at 20 knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts 34 knots or greater and small hail.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Small craft could be damaged in briefly higher winds and
suddenly higher waves.

* The strong thunderstorm will remain over mainly open waters.
properties.instruction:
Move to safe harbor until hazardous weather passes.

Frequent lightning is occurring with this storm. If caught on the
open water stay below deck if possible, keep away from ungrounded
metal objects.
properties.area: Waters from Oregon Inlet to Cape Hatteras NC from 20 to 60 NM; Waters from Cape Hatteras to Ocracoke Inlet NC from 20 to 60 NM
